root_cause.text: The net/core RPS/RFS code reused a cached flow_id computed in get_rps_cpu() when calling set_rps_cpu(), incorrectly assuming different receive queues’ rps_dev_flow_table instances always had the same unchanged size, which could index the wrong table out of bounds.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly says the blamed commit "made the assumption that the RPS table for each receive queue would have the same size, and that it would not change" and warns this could cause "out-of-bound access and/or crashes"; the patch removes flow_id from set_rps_cpu() arguments and recomputes it there with `flow_id = rfs_slot(hash, flow_table);` before indexing `flow_table->flows[flow_id]`.
